# Nanotrasen
Nanotrasen (NT) is the Orion Arm leviathan of a mining company, with its name on anything to do with plasma. NT currently holds a majority stake in the starship fuel market and is by far the wealthiest company in known space. There is not a lot that NT has not dipped its toes into with varying degrees of success. It is one of the very few corporations capable of funding its own private navy.
In the Frontier, NT is a major manufacturer and commercial power. Its shipyards build everything from mining shuttles to energy weapons, its medical division supplies NanoMed vendors, and its contractors are a common sight on Frontier Outpost. NT is not the government, however: it does not own the Frontier Administration, the NFSD, or the bank, and its employees are not the same thing as the sector's free contractors and civilians.
## Epsilon Eridani
A rapidly developing system within the frontier. While NT remains interested in the frontier as a whole, most of its effort seems concentrated around this one star system.
